RAJYA SABHA
—————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the December 12, 2003/Agrahayana 21, 1925 (Saka)
—————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Environment and Forests;
Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development; Ocean
Development; Railways; Science and Technology;
Steel; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total  number  of  questions—20
50
Setting up of an IIT
*161. SHRI C. RAMA-CHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a high level
team of Professors belonging to various
IITs visited Basara in Andhra Pradesh to
study suitability of the site to set up an IIT
in the area;
(b) if so, the findings of the study;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh had
written a letter to Prime Minister
requesting to set up an IIT in Basara, which
has the India's only shrine of Goddess
Saraswati; and
(d) if so, the steps  taken in this
direction?
Use of aluminium and steel in
coaches
*162. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of steel that is roughly
required by the Indian Railways annually;
(b) the quantum of aluminium used in
coaches and wagons by the Indian
Railways;
(c) whether Government are thinking
of using aluminium to manufacture
coaches and wagons for the Indian
Railways; and
(d) if not, the reasons for not using
aluminium in the manufacturing for
coaches and wagons?

Animal welfare schemes
*163. SHRI LALITBHAI MEHTA:
SHRIMATI  SAVI TA  SHARDA:
Will the Minister of ENVIRONMENT
AND FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
considering to handover entire animal
welfare schemes to the Animal Welfare
Board of India;
(b) if so, by when a decision in this
regard is likely to be taken;
(c) the funds allotted to AWBI during
the years 1998-99 to 2002-03; and
(d) the number of institutions registered
by AWBI during the years 1998-99 to
2002-03 and per animal grant the AWBI
could provide to such institutions, yearly?
History textbooks for class XII
*164. SHRI EDUARDO FALEIRO:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Central Board of
Secondary Education recommended a list
of history textbooks for class XII students
of CBSE-affiliated schools;
(b) if so, whether the list includes
textbooks entitled "Modern India" and
"Contemporary World History" brought
out by NCERT in April, 2003 and May,
2003 respectively;
(c) whether the CBSE got these
textbooks evaluated before recommending
them; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Food for work programme in
drought affected areas
†*165. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to provide work to only one person in the
affected family under Food for Work
Scheme for people of drought affected
areas;
(b) if so, the rule being implemented
by Government for allocation of foodgrains
to the families having four five or more
than five members;
(c) whether Government are aware of
the fact that families comprising more than
one number are not getting any benefit of
the said scheme; and
(d) if so, the action government propose
to take in this regard for welfare of such
people?
Reducing import duty on steel
*166. SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of STEEL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government propose to cut
down the import duty on steel;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) whether it would not adversely
affect the interests of indigenous steel
producers?
Recommendations on wildlife
 *167. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) at what stage is the implementation

Relaxation to sportsmen and folk
artists in Railways
†*168. SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of RAILWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the relaxation being
provided to sportsmen and folk artists in
employment has been withdrawn;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the number of persons from arts and
sports, so far, absorbed in various
departments?
Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan

SHRIMATI   KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of HUMAN

pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that States are
showing lukewarm attitude towards the
'Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan’ Scheme of
Government;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government have
considered the recommendations made by

List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of theRajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, the December 12, 2003/Agrahayana 21, 1925 (Saka)

(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Environment and Forests;
Food Processing Industries; Human Resource Development; Ocean
Development; Railways; Science and Technology;
Steel; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions—141
238
Crop estimates
1092. MISS MABEL REBELLO : Will
the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether with good monsoon we
hope to get bumper crop this year; if so,
the estimates of kharif foodgrains, oil seeds,
cotton etc.;
(b) whether this would be an all-time
high record; and
(c) how far it would take us to self-
sufficiency and help us to control prices of
foodgrains and edible oils?
Promotion of fisheries
1093. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of number of fisheries that
were opened by farmers in the last three
years, year-wise and State-wise;
(b) whether Government have taken a
pro-active step to promote fisheries to
farmers of good climatic and water
conditions to improve their economy;
(c) if so, the details of the steps taken
by Government in this regard; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Drought assistance to States
1094. SHRI JANARDHANA
POOJARY: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a number of
States were under grip of severe drought
condition during the last three years;and
(b) if so, the foodgrain and other
assistance released to various States
plagued by drought; State-wise and
year-wise?
Making agriculture remunerative in
Madhya Pradesh
1095. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that agricultural
land in Madhya Pradesh is constantly
turning non-remunerative;

(b) if so, whether Government are going
to take any step or incentive package to
make agriculture remunerative;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Growth targets for Rajasthan
1096. DR. ABRAR AHMED: Will the
Minister of AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) what is the rate of growth targeted
and achieved in agriculture sector in
Rajasthan during the year 2002-03; and
(b) the steps taken to improve the rate
of growth of production in Rajasthan?
Implementation of the APMA
1097. SHRIMATI BIMBA RAIKAR:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Agricultural Produce
Marketing Act prepared by the Centre has
been taken up by the States for
implementation; and
(b) which are the States that have taken
initiatives for the implementation of the
Act?
Assistance to Assam
1098. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the per capita amount allotted for
agriculture during the last five years in the
country particularly for flood affected areas
of Assam; and
(b) the total amount demanded by
Assam Government and the amount
sanctioned by the Central Government for
the purpose during this period?
Promotion of animal husbandry and
dairy in Uttar Pradesh
†1099.DR. AKHTAR HASAN RIZVI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the amount has been
allocated for promoting animal husbandry
and dairying in Uttar Pradesh during the
last three years;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the amount spent for this purpose
during the same period?
Production of rice, wheat and pulses
1100. SHRI SK. KHABIR UDDIN
AHMED: Will the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) per hectare production of rice and
wheat in the country during the last three
years, year-wise and State-wise;
(b) the details of the area under
production of pulses and per hectare
production of pulses during the last three
years, year-wise; and
(c) the details of the measures taken by
Government to match the agricultural
growth rate particularly the pulses with the
rate of population increase?
Schemes for development of
agriculture in Bihar
†1101. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
formulated and implemented any Central

development of agricultural sector in the

of this State;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?

propose to develop fisheries sector to boost
